description: This Python source file defines the CustomOpenAPISpec class, which provides utility methods for customizing, expanding, and integrating Pydantic models into an OpenAPI specification. It includes handling for multiple Pydantic versions, schema addition, schema references rewriting, and specific methods to add schemas for chat completion, embedding, and responses API endpoints, mainly used for documentation purposes within a larger codebase.

classes.name: CustomOpenAPISpec
classes.description: A utility handler for customizing OpenAPI specifications with schema definitions derived from Pydantic models, supporting multiple Pydantic versions and providing methods to add schemas to specific API endpoint paths for documentation purposes.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_pydantic_schema(model_class)
methods.description: Retrieves the JSON schema from a Pydantic model class, handling both v1 and v2 API schema extraction methods with fallback and error handling.

methods.name: None add_schema_to_components(openapi_schema: Dict[str, Any], schema_name: str, schema_def: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Adds a schema definition to the OpenAPI components/schemas section, ensuring proper structure.

methods.name: None add_request_body_to_paths(openapi_schema: Dict[str, Any], paths: List[str], schema_ref: str)
methods.description: Expands the request body schema for given API paths, providing a detailed inline schema for Swagger UI, including handling of nested $defs.

methods.name: None _move_defs_to_components(openapi_schema: Dict[str, Any], defs: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Moves nested $defs from Pydantic v2 schemas into OpenAPI components/schemas for resolution.

methods.name: Any _rewrite_defs_refs(schema: Any)
methods.description: Recursively rewrites $ref references pointing to $defs to point to OpenAPI component schemas instead.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _extract_field_schema(field_def: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates a simplified schema for a Pydantic field, used for form display in Swagger UI.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _expand_field_definition(field_def: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Prepares a full schema definition for inline inclusion in OpenAPI schemas for Swagger UI rendering.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] add_request_schema( openapi_schema: Dict[str, Any], model_class: Type, schema_name: str, paths: List[str], operation_name: str )
methods.description: Generic method to add a Pydantic model schema to the OpenAPI spec and attach it to API paths.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] add_chat_completion_request_schema(openapi_schema: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Adds a specific schema for chat completion request parameters to relevant API endpoints.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] add_embedding_request_schema(openapi_schema: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Adds a specific schema for embedding request parameters to relevant API endpoints.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] add_responses_api_request_schema(openapi_schema: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Adds a specific schema for responses API request parameters to relevant endpoints.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] add_llm_api_request_schema_body(openapi_schema: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Aggregates and adds multiple schemas for LLM API request bodies, including chat, embedding, and responses API schemas, to the specification.
